tools.name: AddDut
tools.description: Adds a Data Unit Type (STRUCT, ENUM, ALIAS, UNION) to the PLC project.

DutType.description: DUT type: Struct, Enum, Alias, Union.

Fields.description: Optional object of field declarations (name = type) for Struct/Union (name = value for Enum). Declaration order is not guaranteed (PowerShell hashtable).

tools.name: AddGvl
tools.description: Adds a Global Variable List (GVL) to the PLC project.

Variables.description: Optional object of variable declarations (name = type). Declaration order is not guaranteed (PowerShell hashtable).

tools.name: AddLibrary
tools.description: Adds a library reference to the PLC project.

Version.description: Optional library version. Uses latest if omitted.

tools.name: AddPou
tools.description: Adds a POU (Program, Function Block, or Function) to the PLC project.

Type.description: POU type: Program, FunctionBlock, or Function.

ReturnType.description: Return type for Functions (e.g., INT, BOOL). Ignored for Program/FunctionBlock.

PlcProjectPath.description: Tree path to the PLC project's POUs folder. Auto-detected if omitted.

tools.name: BuildProject
tools.description: Build the PLC project of the open solution and wait for the result. On BUILD_FAILED read data.errorItems (description/file/line taken from the XAE Error List) instead of guessing; a full build can take several minutes (timeout 600 s). Requires ConnectIde with an open solution.

tools.name: ConnectAds
tools.description: Open the ADS connection to the PLC runtime. Leave AmsNetId empty: it is auto-detected from the IDE target and changes per target (local UmRT, remote CX ...), so never hardcode it. Port defaults to 851 (PLC runtime 1). Requires ConnectIde for auto-detection.

AmsNetId.description: Target AmsNetId. Leave empty to auto-detect from the IDE target (recommended; it differs per target).

tools.name: ConnectIde
tools.description: Connect to a running TwinCAT XAE / Visual Studio instance (found through the Running Object Table); only if none is found does it launch a new XAE. SolutionPath is optional and opens that .sln after connecting. Call this before any project, build or runtime tool. Returns ideProcessId and, when a solution is open, the detected target AmsNetId.

ProgId.description: COM ProgID to connect to / launch. When given, running instances with this ProgID are preferred and only this ProgID is used for launching.

SolutionPath.description: Path to a .sln file. If specified, the IDE will open this solution automatically after connecting (or connect to an instance already running this solution).

NoLaunch.description: If set, do not launch a new IDE instance if none is running.

tools.name: DisconnectAds
tools.description: Close the ADS connection and forget the cached endpoint (disables auto-reconnect).

tools.name: DisconnectIde
tools.description: Release the DTE/COM references held by the bridge. The IDE keeps running unless Quit=true, which closes the solution without saving and quits the IDE (only use on an IDE that ConnectIde launched).

Quit.description: true = also close the solution (without saving) and quit the IDE.

tools.name: EnableConfig
tools.description: Activate the configuration on the target without any dialog. Restarts TwinCAT and downloads/starts the PLC program: the machine stops and restarts. Confirm with the user first. With Force=true it runs the whole lifecycle: Config -> Activate -> wait for Run -> PLC Login+Download -> wait for port 851 -> PLC Run, and reports every step in data.steps. NoLogin=true stops after TwinCAT is in Run (no download, no PLC Run). TwinCAT restarts, so call ConnectAds again afterwards (ReadVariable/WriteVariable also auto-reconnect; data.reconnected tells you). Never add sleeps around this call; it polls until the target state is reached.

Force.description: true = full lifecycle without dialogs (Config -> Activate -> Run -> Login/Download -> PLC Run).

NoLogin.description: true = stop after TwinCAT reaches Run; skip PLC login/download/Run.

TimeoutSec.description: Overall time limit for the whole -Force cycle (single deadline). Default 120.

tools.name: GetBuildErrors
tools.description: Read the compiler messages currently shown in the XAE Error List (errors by default; IncludeWarnings/IncludeMessages add the rest). Needs an English XAE UI (window "Error List", button "N Errors"); other UI languages return ERRORLIST_UNAVAILABLE.

TimeoutSec.description: Hard limit for the UI Automation scan. Default 30.

tools.name: GetIdeInfo
tools.description: Return version, edition, open solution and ITcSysManager availability of the connected IDE. Cheap connectivity check; fails with NOT_CONNECTED before ConnectIde.

tools.name: GetIoTree
tools.description: Reads the current I/O device tree (TIID subtree) and returns as JSON.

tools.name: GetPlcState
tools.description: Read the PLC runtime state (Run/Stop/...) on the connected ADS port.

tools.name: GetPouCode
tools.description: Reads declaration and implementation code from an existing POU.

PouName.description: Name of the POU to read.

PouPath.description: Full tree path to the POU. Auto-detected from PouName if omitted.

tools.name: GetProjectTree
tools.description: Reads and returns the full TwinCAT project structure as a JSON tree.

tools.name: GetSymbols
tools.description: List the PLC symbols of the connected runtime, optionally filtered by a substring (Filter). Use it to find exact variable paths before ReadVariable/WriteVariable.

tools.name: GetSystemState
tools.description: Read the TwinCAT system state (Run/Config) of a target over ADS port 10000. AmsNetId defaults to the IDE target (ConnectIde), then the ADS session (ConnectAds), then the local system 127.0.0.1.1.1; data.amsNetId / data.netIdSource tell which one was used. netIdSource=local means you read the local TwinCAT system, which is usually NOT your target.

AmsNetId.description: Target AmsNetId. Leave empty to use the IDE target, then the ADS session, then the local system 127.0.0.1.1.1 (see data.netIdSource).

tools.name: IoScan
tools.description: Scan the I/O devices (EtherCAT ...) of the target and add them to the I/O tree. Requires the target in Config mode.

tools.name: NewProject
tools.description: Creates a new TwinCAT XAE project with a PLC project and default MAIN program.

Path.description: Directory to create the project in. Defaults to current directory.

tools.name: NewTestCase
tools.description: Build a test case object for RunTest/RunTestCycle. Setup/Teardown are arrays of {Path, Value} writes; Assertions are {Path, Operator, Expected} with Operator one of Equal (default), NotEqual, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, Contains, IsTrue, IsFalse. Pure data, no IDE/PLC access.

Setup.description: Writes before the test: array of {"Path":"MAIN.x","Value":1} (keys Path = PLC symbol path, Value = value to write, converted to the PLC type).

Teardown.description: Writes after the test (also run when the test fails): array of {"Path":"MAIN.x","Value":0} (keys Path, Value).

WaitMs.description: Wait duration in milliseconds before assertions.

Assertions.description: Checks after WaitMs: array of {"Path":"MAIN.y","Operator":"Equal","Expected":1}. Keys: Path (PLC symbol path), Operator (optional, default Equal; one of Equal, NotEqual, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, Contains, IsTrue, IsFalse), Expected (omit for IsTrue/IsFalse). Short forms like "eq"/"gt" are NOT accepted.

tools.name: OpenProject
tools.description: Open a solution (.sln) in the connected IDE and wait until the TwinCAT project is loaded.

tools.name: PlcLogin
tools.description: Login to the PLC project and download the program in one call (Login flag 3, no dialogs). Use after a successful BuildProject when TwinCAT is already in Run; EnableConfig Force=true already includes this step.

PlcProjectPath.description: Tree path to PLC project. Default auto-detects from TIPC.

tools.name: PlcLogout
tools.description: Log out of the PLC project (the runtime keeps running).

tools.name: ReadVariable
tools.description: Read one or more PLC variables by symbol path (e.g. ["MAIN.nCounter","GVL.bRun"]) via ADS. Path is always an array, even for a single variable. Values are typed by the PLC type (BOOL/INT/REAL/STRING ...; structs come back as byte arrays). Requires ConnectAds (auto-reconnects after EnableConfig).

Path.description: Array of PLC symbol paths, e.g. ["MAIN.nCounter"]. Always an array, also for a single variable.

tools.name: RunTest
tools.description: Execute one test case created with NewTestCase (setup writes -> wait -> assertions -> teardown writes) against the connected PLC. Requires ConnectAds.

TestCase.description: A test case object as returned by NewTestCase.

tools.name: RunTestCycle
tools.description: Builds, activates (TwinCAT restart) and runs the PLC: changes the running machine. Confirm with the user first. Full automated test cycle: build (unless SkipBuild), activate configuration, login, run every test case from NewTestCase, then stop the PLC (unless KeepRunning). Returns per-test results. Can take many minutes (timeout 900 s).

TestCases.description: Array of test case objects as returned by NewTestCase.

SkipBuild.description: Skip the build step (if already built).

KeepRunning.description: Don't stop the PLC after tests complete.

tools.name: SendPlcProgram
tools.description: Download the compiled PLC program to the target (alias of PlcLogin: Login+Download without dialogs).

PlcProjectPath.description: Tree path to PLC project. Default auto-detects from TIPC.

tools.name: SetPlcState
tools.description: Switch the PLC runtime to Run, Stop or Reset and wait for the state. WARNING: on a UmRT (user-mode runtime) target, Reset kills TcSystemServiceUm and you must EnableConfig again. Prefer Run/Stop.

State.description: Run, Stop or Reset. Reset kills TcSystemServiceUm on a UmRT target.

TimeoutSec.description: Maximum wait for Run/Stop to be reached. Default 30.

tools.name: SetSystemState
tools.description: Switch TwinCAT to Run or Config via ADS WriteControl (no StartRestartTwinCAT dialog) and poll until the state is reached. Switching to Config stops the runtime: all outputs go to zero. Does not download the PLC program; EnableConfig Force=true is the usual choice.

AmsNetId.description: Target AMS Net ID. Auto-detected from IDE if omitted.

TimeoutSec.description: Maximum time to wait for the target state. Default 60.

tools.name: SetTarget
tools.description: Sets the target system AMS Net ID for deployment.

AmsNetId.description: Target AMS Net ID (e.g., "127.0.0.1.1.1" for local).

tools.name: SetVariableLink
tools.description: Links a PLC variable to an I/O channel.

tools.name: WatchVariable
tools.description: Poll one PLC variable every IntervalMs for DurationMs and return the samples. The condition-based mode (Until) is a PowerShell scriptblock and is NOT available through MCP; use repeated ReadVariable calls instead. Requires ConnectAds.

TimeoutMs.description: Max wait time for condition. Default: 5000.

tools.name: WritePouCode
tools.description: Writes declaration and/or implementation code into an existing POU.

PouName.description: Name of the POU to write to.

PouPath.description: Full tree path to the POU. Auto-detected from PouName if omitted.

tools.name: WriteVariable
tools.description: Write a single PLC variable by symbol path via ADS. Writes directly into the running PLC; may drive outputs or axes. Confirm with the user first. Value is converted to the PLC type of the symbol (send JSON bool for BOOL, number for numeric types, string for STRING). Requires ConnectAds.

Value.description: New value; JSON bool, number or string matching the PLC type of the symbol.
